$comment: Single source of truth for the Pathfinder Content Security Policy (modernization-plan §4
Phase 3). This policy is validated against index.html's external assets + the documented
runtime origins by scripts/check-csp.mjs (npm run check:csp), so the policy cannot silently
drift from the dependencies the app actually uses.
DEPLOYMENT STATUS: not yet enforced. GitHub Pages cannot set response headers, and a <meta>
CSP cannot be report-only, so enforcing this safely requires either (a) moving to a host that
supports response headers (Netlify/Cloudflare/_headers) and shipping it report-only first, or
(b) verifying an enforcing <meta> against the real Google signInWithPopup flow (which broke
under previously-attempted meta CSPs). See docs/content-security-policy.md. When enforced, the

rationale.style-src 'unsafe-inline': index.html uses a small number of inline style= attributes; the theme engine also writes CSS variables via CSSOM (not governed by style-src).
rationale.img-src data:: favicon is a data: SVG URI; canvas-derived images are same-origin.
rationale.connect-src firestore.googleapis.com: Firestore reads/writes (progress, submissions, published levels, ratings).
rationale.frame-src accounts.google.com / *.fireba: Google sign-in popup (signInWithPopup) and the Firebase auth handler iframe.
rationale.worker-src 'self' blob:: Off-thread solver Web Worker (new Worker(url, { type: 'module' })).

requiredRuntimeOrigins.$comment: Origins the app contacts at runtime that do NOT appear as src/href URLs in index.html, so check:third-party can't see them — listed here so check:csp still guarantees the CSP covers them.
